correctness.rationale: The full Singer normalizer acts without inversions on the binary rank-four spherical building. Solomon–Tits makes the 2-complex simply connected before quotient. Frobenius fixes the point F2·1, and Armstrong with conjugation f a f^-1=a² kills both generators of its quotient fundamental group. Independent direct-orbit and Burnside fixed-flag enumerations certify (4,9,7) quotient cells and Euler characteristic two. A simply connected 2-dimensional CW complex with H2=Z is homotopy equivalent to S² by Hurewicz and Whitehead.

value.rationale: A canonical Singer normalizer that arises naturally in affine-building stabilizer constructions has a finite spherical-link action with a complete quotient homotopy type. The fixed-point normal-closure argument and exact flag orbit census reveal a genuinely simply connected 2-sphere quotient, going beyond character averages or homology alone. The concrete smallest rank-four binary example is a motivated test case for understanding nonfree semilinear actions on buildings.
